1 أَرَتِ الدَّابَّةُ مَرْبَطَهَا , (M, K,) and مِعْلَفَهَا, [aor. تَأْرِى,] inf. n. أَرْىٌ, (M,) The beast kept to its place where it was tied, (M, K,) and to its manger. (M.) ―
-b2- أَرَتِ الدَّابِّةُ إِلَى الدَّابَّةِ, (K,) aor. as above, (S,) and so the inf. n., (TA,) The beast joined itself, or became joined, to the beast, and kept with it to one manger. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
